title: BehaviorEvent
description: Wire format for kernel-derived behavior records emitted by an in-VM tracer (reference producer: bloodhound). One UTF-8 NDJSON record per line. This schema is the workspace-canonical source of truth; producers and consumers vendor it byte-for-byte with a commit pin (see docs/spec/behavior_event/README.md §4 for the compatibility model).

header.description: Correlation metadata shared across all event types.

timestamp.description: CLOCK_MONOTONIC nanoseconds in the observed VM. Comparable within one boot only; not wall-clock time and not a total kernel causal order. NDJSON line position is the emission order.

auid.description: Audit User ID (Login UID). Survives privilege escalation.

sessionid.description: Audit Session ID assigned by the kernel at login.

pid.description: Thread-group ID (TGID) of the process that produced the event.

process_ref.description: Stable process-instance reference within one kernel boot and the PID namespace observed by the producer. Omitted when the producer cannot read a complete stable reference; never a PID-only substitute.

event.description: Classification of the captured behavior. The pedagogical layer (L1/L2/L3) is not part of the contract; consumers derive it from (type, name) per docs/spec/behavior_event/README.md §3. Producers may carry additional keys (bloodhound emits a legacy `layer`); consumers MUST NOT depend on them.

type.description: Source class of the event. SYSCALL/TTY/PACKET/KPROBE/TRACEPOINT/LSM are kernel-derived. LIFECYCLE is a kernel-observed process-lifecycle marker (process_start, process_fork, process_exit), with userspace bootstrap for processes that predate attachment. HEARTBEAT carries periodic drop / utilisation deltas. USDT is emitted only by compiled, verified in-tree collectors. DIAGNOSTIC reports bounded collector, process-identity, or stream health state. META carries tracer-emitted metadata records (e.g., bloodhound_ready, exec_entry_network_context).

name.description: Specific hook name (e.g., openat, tty_write) or META/LIFECYCLE/HEARTBEAT/USDT/DIAGNOSTIC event name.

proc.description: Process context. Optional; fields are best-effort.

main_executable.description: Absolute path to the binary; best-effort, may be empty for short-lived processes.

cwd.description: Current working directory at event time.

args.description: Event-type-specific payload. The field set is producer-defined; consumers should treat unknown keys permissively. The common fields below have fixed types wherever they appear.

data.description: Base64-encoded raw bytes (TTY input/output, packet payload).

raw_args.description: Raw syscall arguments as integers (Tier 1 raw SYSCALL events).

return_code.description: Exit code or syscall return value, when applicable.
